classification: Source-derived tag format; provisional pending resolution of contradictions in the manual.
format: GGSSII MMYY LL DD NNNN (remove spaces when encoding as a string)

segments.meaning: Unique asset ID number assigned at registration

worked_example.source_explanation: 03 Furniture and Fixture; 01 Table; 19 Employee Table; 0122 purchase MM/YY; 01 Head Office; 09 Finance and Accounts; 0001 Asset ID.

operational_rules.rule: Assign a unique identification number to each fixed asset and record the tag number in the fixed asset register.
Affix permanently in a readily visible/accessibly viewable place; place consistently on similar asset types.
Use RFID tag paper or sticker; manual also describes QR Code Tag for the identification number.
If physically impracticable or tagging would affect warranty, maintain an untagged-asset file and record detailed traceability specifications in the register/module.
Update identification when registering and keep asset information current for changes in location, condition, cost, model and serial number.

source_conflicts.issue: Worked example conflicts with the official group list: example uses group 03 for Furniture and Fixture, while the group list assigns 03 Building and 05 Furniture and Fixture.
Worked example uses subgroup 01 for Table; the detailed Annexure-5 catalog identifies Table as subgroup 08 and its item list uses item codes starting at 23.
Manual narrative describes the segment labels and widths in a diagram with ambiguous alignment; the worked 16-digit example yields a 2+2+2+4+2+2+4 layout.

recommendation: Do not issue production tags from the worked example until the responsible authority confirms the controlling code list and validates a canonical tag specification.
